summary: Integration part 2 of 2 (2026-10-23, about 14:45-16:30 UTC; API 8716, Vite 5186, the only agent editing). Every item of part 1's 'part2' list, the orchestrator's round-4 carry-over and the validation review's leftovers is done: (1) backend: an outage of the source lists is HTTP 503 'The fire lists could not be reached right now; try again later.' (catalog.ListsUnavailable; build gate, build job, incident GET, incident record, extras), never 'a local or synthetic bundle'; several WFIGS records with the fire's own name are one record (the Lucas Fire now shows its CALNU LUCAS record, live check); firms.load_live_ca/load_year_ca, catalog.HISTORICAL_YEAR and pipeline.spec_incident_id are gone (observed.la_time -> fire_local_time); INTERIM_LFM_WARNING no longer says 'until a regional method is tested' (old text removed on rebuild); AccuracyFire.growth_ratio_median per fire, regional_accuracy.json regenerated from validation's fires file (15 values added, nothing else changed). (2) web: the feed and the panels use one time for local officials' messages (a replay lists a message from the minute after it was sent; 'sent less than a minute after this time'; minute-cut spans, tested at 5:45:12 and 5:45:30 PM MDT on Horse Gulch); the accuracy label from validation's real results: Public's first view names the region and says in words, with no number, how the forecast did ('much less new spread than really happened', 'too much new spread on one fire and too little on the other'), the score and each test fire's score one tap away (two decimals, never '0.2-0.2'), plain words for the weather, a fuel caveat that means something when every fuel group was tested, Command 'of 1', the region, 'forecast/real growth', the ratio by fire, GSI explained, the region's caveats in the Analysis drawer; round-2 decision 7 kept; 'Analysis ready: spread reconstruction (no model run yet)' for bundles without a model run; a 503 reads 'Unavailable right now'. (3) docs: CONTRACT §14 folds contract3/validation.md (14.4 / 14.12.10 / 14.12.13) and every part-2 change; SPEC §8.4 GSI paragraph, 503 gate, AccuracyFire; validation.md 10.11 says 6 days. (4) optional items: a flight requested just before the map exists is flown (part 1's known issue); the Public compact summary already had the local alerts line. (5) the end-to-end check on real data (65 brief3-final screenshots, every one viewed) found and fixed five small bugs: 'Checking… (Cal OES)' for a North Carolina fire, a long verbatim sender name running past the panel, 'Hulsey Bench · 0 ac' on the map, a fire-name search right after page load answering 'No listed fire … matches' before the 2025 list arrived, and the region caveats not shown anywhere. Gates: backend 990 passed; web typecheck 0, lint 55 (all src/scene), 75 files 1,186 passed 2 skipped, build OK; check-time-api 0/0; 1,020 GET and 0 non-GET API requests, 0 builds. Part 1 (earlier): Part 1 of the brief-3 integration, done while validation still builds in the same tree. (1) Time API: tf is required at the five §14.9.6 shims; the 19 Pacific-bound lib/time names and the deprecated exports insideCalifornia, NOT_FIRE_SPECIFIC, fmtStatusTime, feed topic 'calfire', useCalfire, fill_from_calfire and overpass.la_time are deleted; check-time-api on web/src: 0 deprecated uses, 0 America/Los_Angeles literals. (2) Contracts: the (R) fields are required in contracts.py (LiveStatus.detections_24h, IncidentListResponse.sources, FireWeatherResponse.states_checked/alert_states, FireWeatherAlert.time_zone), in web/src/api/types.ts (the five IncidentSummary fields, sources, detections_24h), web/src/official/types.ts and web/src/extras/types.ts (new EvacSource, states, zone props); the parity test covers the official shapes. (3) test_api.py build-gate hand-off done (exact 14.2 texts at the API, alias and 422 cases). (4) Review leftovers fixed: local officials' alerts outside the lower 48 answer 'not checked' from the backend (N2), the location card lists every message of the point's own box answer (N3), an open fire's data sources credit TIGERweb, NTAD and NWCG (us-web N1), a past record's update time keeps its year in the Public summary. (5) Two bugs found in the browser checks and fixed: picking an unprepared fire's card (Little Giant, WA) opened the nearby prepared Lower Sugarloaf Fire instead (zoom focus now held for the card's flight); the location card at a past time in a state without an evacuation feed said 'not shown for past dates' instead of 'not available in this state'. (6) CONTRACT §14 gains '14.0 as built' to '14.14 as built' sub-headings folding the four wave-1 notes, plus the §14.5 several-records case, §14.7 MultiPolygon and county matches, and the decision to keep the hourly re-check of a daily Open-Meteo block (§14.12.2); SPEC follows. (7) Verified in the browser at 1440x900 and 390x844 in Public and Command (33 screenshots, each viewed); gates pass. Validation's files were not touched; what needs them is in 'part2'.

issues.N4-regression (round 3): confirmed and fixed. Verified first in the browser (Horse Gulch, t=1720655400000, Jul 10, 2024 5:50 PM MDT): Public Details listed MTHelenaPoliceDepartment's 'Urgent! Evacuation for Horse Gulch Fire ...' (sent 5:45 PM, effective and onset 5:00 PM) with 'not yet in effect' and the short Official-now line quoted the 3:53 PM Cave Gulch message; the re-checker's phone shot at 2:50 PM (t=1720644600000) had no Updates badge. Cause: the query's at_ms is hour-quantised (fireWeatherAtMs -> extrasAtMs), the backend's phase is decided at that hour, and round 3's toLocalAlertItem / officialBadge judged against requested_at_ms (the hour) while localPhaseText used the panel's time. Fix (web only): official/localAlerts.ts localPhaseAt decides each message's phase from its own times at the panel's time refMs: in effect when sent_ms <= refMs, max(sent, onset else effective) <= refMs and expires_ms is null or later; 'sent N min after this time' when sent_ms > refMs (never current, never counted); 'not yet in effect' only when sent and its own onset still ahead; ended from its expiry or for a Cancel. localAlertsState(q, { refMs }) decides at the given time (else requested_at_ms, else now_ms; the backend's phase is only the hint for an answer with no time at all); localAlertsAt(l, refMs) re-decides the phases and the order at another time (the same object when nothing changes). Callers: useOfficialNow at the new useOfficialPanelTime() (official/context.ts: now for a live fire or no fire, else the replay minute: the rule of Official now, Public's short summary and the location card); useOfficialAtPoint and the feed (extras/runtime.ts) at the official context's refMs; LocalAlertsRow, localAlertsLine and localAlertLines re-decide at the time their panel passes; officialBadge(evac, fw, local, refMs) re-decides at refMs and useOfficialBadge passes useOfficialPanelTime(). LocalAlertItem gains onsetMs (onset, else effective) and cancelled. Design: the query stays hour-quantised because the answer at an hour lists every message sent in [hour - 24 h, hour + 1 h] (nws.PAST_BEFORE_MS / PAST_AFTER_MS; openfema.answer), which covers every minute of that hour, so the web decides at the minute with no refetch while the timeline is scrubbed or played, and the per-URL cache and the backend's archive cache stay keyed by the hour (an exact-time query would be a request per minute of scrubbing). Backend unchanged except a docstring sentence in nws.local_phase.
